name: Baga Road Market
placement: ground-mounted inside the compound wall (no mapped building is the site's own)
battery_room: 42.0 kWh in a lockable room or steel cage

security.measure: build community ownership (the ward committee or market association holds the asset)
security.basis: World Bank, 'Solar Pumping: The Basics' (2018), p. 27 to 28

security.measure: site arrays where people pass regularly, on roofs out of public reach where the roof fits
security.basis: World Bank, 'Solar Pumping: The Basics' (2018), p. 27 to 28

security.measure: ground arrays only inside the compound wall or a fence
security.basis: World Bank, 'Solar Pumping: The Basics' (2018), p. 27 to 28

security.measure: tamper-proof or spot-welded bolts and anti-theft mounting frames
security.basis: World Bank, 'Solar Pumping: The Basics' (2018), p. 27 to 28

security.measure: motion sensors and alarms; guards where the site already has them
security.basis: World Bank, 'Solar Pumping: The Basics' (2018), p. 27 to 28

security.measure: battery in a lockable room or a steel cage
remote monitoring with alerts on output, battery and door
no new exposed line: the system sits behind the meter inside the compound

ownership.owns: a cold-room operator or the market association
ownership.pays: traders, pay per crate per day: N100 (up to N250 quoted)
ownership.repairs: the operator, paid from the storage fees
ownership.precedent: ColdHubs pay-as-you-store model: 7 units in Northeast Nigeria markets (Dec 2020 to Jan 2021), N100 per crate per day, about USD 40,000 per unit and USD 150 a month to run (IFPRI, 2023)

labels.roof: footprints from OSM building outlines: the buildings touching the site's own OSM outline, else the buildings containing the site point, else the single nearest building within 30 m; usable roof = footprint x an ASSUMPTION usable share (0.3 to 0.7) x an ASSUMPTION 0.12 to 0.20 kWp per m2; no building: ground inside the compound, or unknown where OSM maps no building within 250 m
labels.security: each measure names its basis: the World Bank's anti-theft list, or our design standard
labels.ownership: PROPOSED model with the precedent named in each row; operators to be confirmed with partners
labels.load: one ColdHubs-type room per market (about 3 t, 150 crates, 5.5 kWp; VERIFIED_SECONDARY); no kWh/day is published, so the load is DERIVED as the array's mean daily yield here, 25.1 kWh/day (24.6 to 25.8 over the weather years), 24 h
labels.lga: LGA of the nearest health facility
